hero.title: Youth-led innovation for digital, intercultural, and sustainable futures
hero.subtitle: Erasmus+, AI labs, social entrepreneurship, and exchange experiences — all designed by young people, for young people.

focusAreas.title: What we do
focusAreas.subtitle: Four interconnected pathways to transformative learning:

about.pageSubtitle: Internationaler Jugend- und Bildungsverein Kaiserslautern e.V. is a youth-led NGO shaping digital, intercultural, and sustainable futures through Erasmus+ collaborations.

originStory.title: Our origin story
originStory.subtitle: Born from a Youth Group, scaled into a European youth powerhouse.
originStory.description: IJBK e.V. evolved from the Studentisches Netzwerk der RPTU (OID E10322231) to a registered non-profit on 8 July 2025. Today, we design experiences where young people from every background learn, travel, and build purposeful projects together.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.subtitle: To empower youth through digital skills, sustainable thinking, creative collaboration, and European exchange.

digitalSkills.title: Digital Skills & AI
digitalSkills.description: Comprehensive digital literacy, AI ethics, and hands-on prototyping sessions that unlock employability and confidence.

entrepreneurship.title: Social Entrepreneurship
entrepreneurship.description: Incubating youth-led solutions with measurable impact, mentoring, and investor-ready storytelling.

intercultural.title: Intercultural Learning
intercultural.description: Immersive Erasmus+ exchanges that weave together languages, food, art, and collaborative project delivery.

sustainability.title: Sustainability
sustainability.description: From climate literacy to low-waste events and outdoor learning labs across Kaiserslautern's forests.

innovationFirst.title: Innovation first
innovationFirst.text: Piloting AI, digital tools, and creative facilitation to keep youth learning magnetic.

radicalInclusion.title: Radical inclusion
radicalInclusion.text: Designing access-first experiences: scholarships, safe spaces, and diverse facilitators.

sustainability.title: Sustainability in action
sustainability.text: Every trip and workshop considers footprints, local partners, and lasting change.

coCreation.title: Co-creation
coCreation.text: We build with youth, not for youth — from agenda design to evaluation.

footer.tagline: Building digital, intercultural, and sustainable futures together.
